proposed.explanation: The profit belonging to Talaat Moustafa's own shareholders (Shareholders of the Parent Company) was 14,383,890,306 LE in 2025 compared to 9,025,066,065 LE in 2024 (Restated). This represents an increase of 5,358,824,241 LE or approximately 59.38 percent. Furthermore, net profit for the year (consolidated) reached 18,201,981,482 LE in 2025 up from 12,769,517,325 LE in 2024, and earnings per share rose to 6.98 LE from 4.38 LE. Given your long-term growth goal and high willingness to accept losses, this strong fundamental performance supports retaining the existing holding. However, no additional shares are bought because your current holding of 500 shares at the price of 82.50 LE is valued at 41,250.00 LE, which already represents more than half of your total portfolio value of 71,250.00 LE (30,000.00 LE cash plus 41,250.00 LE holdings). Buying more would violate the portfolio diversification rule that no single company may exceed half of the portfolio's total value. Therefore, holding the position and keeping the cash is the appropriate action.
